In the second quarter of the college football game between UCLA and Oregon, scheduled for October 10 at 3:30 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Oregon" if Oregon outscore UCLA by 3 or more points in the second quarter.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "UCLA".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
